#### `places_block` {#places_block}

<p class="fl-facts">required · block</p>

**The block spread across the faces.**

Its direction states are written as it goes, so it must be a block type that can face several ways at once.

#### `search_range` {#search_range}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer · range [1, 64]</p>

**How many attempts a candidate position gets before the feature moves on.**

Nothing to do with snap_to_surface's key of the same name, and not a distance: the feature tries the origin first and then its neighbours one step away, and this is how many times one position is attempted. Nothing about the attempt changes between tries, so raising it does not widen anything -- the key that grows a patch is chance_of_spreading.

#### `can_place_on_floor` {#can_place_on_floor}

<p class="fl-facts">required · boolean</p>

**Allows the block to attach to the top of a block below it.**

At least one of the three can_place_on_* flags must be on or nothing can ever attach.

#### `can_place_on_ceiling` {#can_place_on_ceiling}

<p class="fl-facts">required · boolean</p>

**Allows the block to attach to the underside of a block above it.**

At least one of the three can_place_on_* flags must be on or nothing can ever attach.

#### `can_place_on_wall` {#can_place_on_wall}

<p class="fl-facts">required · boolean</p>

**Allows the block to attach to the four vertical sides.**

All four horizontal directions are covered by this single flag.

#### `chance_of_spreading` {#chance_of_spreading}

<p class="fl-facts">required · number · range [0, 1]</p>

**Chance that a block just written goes on to spread further.**

Rolled only when the write actually CHANGED something -- adding a face to a block that already had it costs no roll and cannot spread. On a hit the block grows on from that face in a random direction, which is what makes patches rather than single blocks.

#### `can_place_on` {#can_place_on}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · blockList</p>

**Restricts which blocks the spread is willing to attach to.**

Leaving the key out puts no constraint on the supporting block at all -- the three can_place_on_* flags then decide everything. Written, it must not be empty.

Optional, minimum 1 entry when written.
